title: Ubuntu Fieldworks existing-site rescue

job.buyer: Director of a small environmental field-services company
job.request: Rescue the supplied weak website copy and capability notes. Rebuild the public-facing site around supported services and one legitimate case example.

case_context.buyer_problem: Prospective clients cannot tell from the current site what the company actually does, where it works or which claims are supported.
case_context.desired_outcome: A clear, modern website that explains field sampling, GIS support and compliance documentation without repeating unsupported marketing claims.

source_documents.text:
OLD WEBSITE COPY
UBUNTU FIELDWORKS - SOUTH AFRICA'S LEADING ENVIRONMENTAL INNOVATION PARTNER!!!
We deliver world-class revolutionary solutions for every environmental problem.
Trusted by major organisations everywhere.
Services mentioned elsewhere on the site: field sampling, GIS mapping support, environmental compliance documentation.
Contact details on old footer: info@ubuntufieldworks.example

CAPABILITY STATEMENT - CURRENT
Company: Ubuntu Fieldworks
Operating base: Polokwane, Limpopo.
Supported services:
1. Environmental field sampling.
2. GPS/GIS field-data capture and map preparation support.
3. Environmental compliance documentation support.
Team experience: fieldwork across Limpopo and Mpumalanga.
No formal market-leadership ranking is held.

APPROVED ANONYMISED CASE EXAMPLE
Water-quality monitoring assignment, Limpopo, 2025.
Ubuntu Fieldworks collected field samples at 18 monitoring points and delivered a structured field-data pack to the client's environmental specialist.
Client identity is confidential.
No performance percentage or testimonial is available.

constraints: Remove or qualify unsupported market-leadership, world-class, trusted-by and universal-solution claims.
Use only supported services from the current capability statement.
Do not invent environmental authorisations or professional registrations.
